steps.name: test_password_gate_blocks_access
steps.notes: Fresh install (brand-new simulator instance + fresh dev-client asset install). On launch the app shows a full-screen password gate: title 'Notes', 'Enter password to unlock', a TextField (testID password-input) with SecureTextField trait, and an 'Unlock' button (testID unlock-button). Screenshot confirmed typed text renders as masked dots. No note titles/previews/counts/timestamps anywhere in the element tree.

steps.name: test_empty_and_wrong_password_rejected
steps.notes: Empty submit: stayed on gate, StaticText 'Password is required' appeared. Wrong password 'wrong-password' submitted via Unlock button: stayed on gate, StaticText 'Incorrect password' appeared, no note data visible.

steps.name: test_correct_password_unlocks
steps.notes: Correct password unlocked to notes list. Empty state 'No notes yet. Tap "New Note" to create one.' shown. 'New Note' button (testID new-note-button) present, plus a search field.

steps.name: test_session_persists_within_app
steps.notes: New Note opened the editor (keyboard visible, body TextArea focused); Back returned to the list with no password re-prompt. The empty note was listed with placeholder title 'New Note' and timestamp '2026-07-10 22:20' matching current UTC time.

steps.name: test_relaunch_relocks_app
steps.notes: Cold relaunch (lim ios terminate-app + reopen dev-client URL): password gate shown again, no note data visible while locked. Re-entering 'my-notes-are-mine' restored the notes list with the previously created note.

steps.name: test_background_foreground_does_not_lose_state
steps.notes: Created note with body 'Session test note', returned to list (saved, timestamp 2026-07-10 22:22 UTC, correct). Backgrounded by launching Settings, foregrounded via launch-app (no termination; 'Return to Settings' breadcrumb confirmed). App remained unlocked, no crash, 'Session test note' still listed.

steps.name: test_note_data_persists_across_relaunch_behind_gate
steps.notes: Cold relaunch: gate appeared first, no note content visible while locked. After unlock, list showed 'Session test note' (2026-07-10 22:22) and the empty 'New Note'. Opening the note showed editor TextArea value 'Session test note'.

notes: Fresh state mechanism: brand-new Limrun simulator instance (ios_useb_01kx71jwe3ftq9cn3dewhx7rd7) with the shared dev-client asset installed; Metro for RUN_DIR/app on port 8093 via exp.direct tunnel (bundle request observed in this Metro's logs). All timestamps matched YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm in UTC (verified against date -u). All non-fatal verifications also passed.
